summary: The audit checks ARTHIST 5 and four electives, any ARTHIST course, all taken for a letter grade, toward the 25 units the minor needs. If your electives carry fewer than 5 units each, another ARTHIST course makes up the difference. At most one course (up to 5 units) from another university or Bing Overseas Studies may count; you move it in by hand.

program.why: Grading: "Courses must be taken for a letter grade."

QZ3gSbsz.why: "Students must complete a total of 4 Art History elective courses. Any ARTHIST course may be applied toward the Art History elective requirement."

add.why: The Bulletin's "Minimum Units in the Program" is 25, and "Any ARTHIST course may be applied toward the Art History elective requirement." Four electives of 4 units fall short of it, so further ARTHIST courses count toward the total.
